subsystem.name: GenericRuntimeObjects
subsystem.responsibility: Generic runtime object support layer: counted-loop iteration helpers, vehicle physics-body state, fixed-stride element/proximity processing, large UI control-window construction with per-sub-control blocks, reusable linked-node initializers, and session/scoring struct reset.

source_proposals.summary: Reconstructs the generic runtime object layer from twelve validated functions. One DERIVED UI control-window constructor (0x004A70E0) builds a window with ~200 per-sub-control blocks via a uniform block-initializer pattern (GUESS interface ISubControlBlockInitializer). Four GUESS classes cover vehicle physics-body state (0x0045A8E0), fixed-stride element/proximity processing (0x004047D0), a reusable three-field linked node (0x004BAC20), and a session/scoring reset struct (0x004BB950). Seven functions (counted-loop helper 0x00401000, guarded mutex trigger 0x00406640, three getters/accessors, a flag dispatch wrapper, and a null subroutine) have UNKNOWN owners and are kept unowned. No state machine evidence was found. Field semantics and several owner identities remain unresolved; the bulk sub-control-block field offsets are preserved in UIControlWindow's evidence without forcing per-block meaning.

function_roles.role: Generic counted-loop iteration helper: invokes a caller-supplied __thiscall callback a4 over a3 elements, advancing the element pointer by stride a2 each iteration; returns the last callback result (or a3-1 when count is zero).

Counted element-loop driver: reads element count from this+0x130, loops calling VehicleProximity (0x004FB2E0) per element of the +0x134 table with a 316-byte stride; invoked from heightfield collision processing (0x00404250).

Guarded mutex trigger: compares this+0xC with argument a2; on match acquires a mutex via MutexLockWithTimeout(1) and returns the lock result, otherwise returns the field value unchanged (not a pure getter).
Trivial read-only getter returning the DWORD at this+0x4.
Trivial read-only getter returning the DWORD at this+0x54.

Vehicle physics body update: writes requested speed limit to +0x24, clamps against +0x1C/+0x20 bounds, runs the velocity/angular-velocity integrator (0x00459AE0) at step 0.0125 when +0xD0 is enabled, computes attitude angles, emits 3D position via 0x0054B4D0, and handles out-of-range/reset paths.
Double-indirected byte accessor: loads the object pointer stored at this+0x0 and returns the BYTE at obj+0x20.
Byte-offset flag dispatch: forms &this[a2] and forwards it to BitFlagSetter (0x004649F0) to set a single bit; used by the entity visibility grid manager.

Constructor of a large UI control window: zeroes the leading callback/state dwords and byte flag, seeds ~200 sub-control blocks with sentinel defaults, vtable pointers from the fixed table 0x005ACB6C..0x005ACBFC, state dword 0 and target/sentinel -1, zeroes tail flags, then applies player-options defaults (0x004AA270).
Reusable three-field node initializer: stores a2 at this+0x0 (data), nulls this+0x4 (next), stores byte flag a3 at this+0x8; used across directory, collision, physics, AI, and network callers.

Session/scoring struct reset: frees owned allocations +0x8C/+0x90/+0x94, counts '1' entries of the +0x94 array into +0x98 before freeing, reinitializes ~40 scalar fields with -1.0/0/-1 defaults, memsets the trailing 0x28-byte block to 0xFF, and returns -1.
Null subroutine: body has no executable statements and returns immediately (IDA nullsub_134 marker; the MK_FP retaddr expression is a decompiler artifact of a bare ret).

class_proposals.name: UIControlWindow
class_proposals.responsibility: Large UI control window object: leading callback/state dwords, a ~200-element array of per-sub-control blocks (each holding a vtable header, a state dword reset to 0, and a target/sentinel dword set to -1), tail flags, and player-options defaults; constructed by 0x004A70E0.

class_proposals.name: VehiclePhysicsBody
class_proposals.responsibility: Vehicle physics body state: speed-limit storage and clamping, velocity/angular-velocity integration (step 0.0125), attitude-angle computation, 3D position doubles, and conditional reset paths; updated by 0x0045A8E0.

class_proposals.name: HeightfieldProximityProcessor
class_proposals.responsibility: Processes a fixed-stride element table anchored at +0x134 with count at +0x130, driving VehicleProximity (0x004FB2E0) per element; invoked from heightfield collision processing.

class_proposals.name: GenericLinkedNode
class_proposals.responsibility: Reusable three-field linked node (data dword, next pointer, byte flag) initialized by 0x004BAC20; used as a node constructor across directory, collision, physics, AI, and network subsystems.

class_proposals.name: SessionScoringManager
class_proposals.responsibility: Racing/session scoring management struct: owns three allocations (+0x8C, +0x90, +0x94), a '1'-counted byte array, ~40 scalar/vector fields with -1.0/0/-1 defaults, and a trailing 0x28-byte 0xFF-sentinel block; reset by 0x004BB950.

interfaces.name: ISubControlBlockInitializer
interfaces.purpose: Uniform per-sub-control-block construction invoked by UIControlWindow::Initialize (0x004A70E0): each member constructs one block (sentinel seed, vtable header, state reset) via stride-based loops and batch iteration (0x00401000).

compatibility_contracts.name: UIWindowSubControlInit
compatibility_contracts.description: Constructing the profile/exists UI window must zero the leading callback/state fields (+0x0..+0x10), seed every sub-control block with sentinel defaults, assign vtable pointers from the fixed table 0x005ACB6C..0x005ACBFC, reset each block's state dword to 0 and target/sentinel to -1, zero the tail flags, and apply player-options defaults (0x004AA270).

compatibility_contracts.name: VehiclePhysicsBodySpeedLimit
compatibility_contracts.description: A speed-limit request must be stored at +0x24, clamped against the +0x1C/+0x20 bounds, and, when within bounds and integration enabled (+0xD0), integrated at step 0.0125 and emitted as 3D position (+0xD8/+0xE0/+0xE8) via 0x0054B4D0; out-of-range requests follow the clamp or reset path.

compatibility_contracts.name: SessionScoringStructReset
compatibility_contracts.description: Resetting the session/scoring struct must free the +0x8C, +0x90, and +0x94 allocations, count '1' entries of the +0x94 byte array into +0x98 before freeing, restore ~40 scalar fields (floats to -1.0, indexes to 0/-1), memset the trailing 0x28 bytes to 0xFF, and return -1.

subsystem.name: GenericRuntimeObjects
subsystem.responsibility: Miscellaneous runtime helper objects that operate on the F1CVehicle race struct and its per-driver AI sub-state: track spline lookup with fallback interpolation, generic linked-list traversal, a seven-mode scene-object loader state machine, a named format-entry list, AI steering decomposition/state helpers, tire-compound tier selection, and single-field getters/clamps.

source_proposals.summary: Derived architecture proposal for 16 validated functions in scope generic_runtime_objects. Three packet-CONFIRMED owner functions form an F1CVehicle method set (0x00423E80 race-struct init, 0x00424B20 per-frame AI camera viewport/frustum + AI-state reset, 0x00429960 per-frame AI pit-stop strategy). Two packet-DERIVED owner functions form an AIDriver method set (0x00424080 per-driver AI ability config load, 0x00426100 per-frame steering-angle computation). The remaining eleven functions have packet-UNKNOWN owners and are grouped into a GUESS GenericRuntimeObject class (0x00403CD0 spline node lookup, 0x00407DD0 list traversal, 0x0040F1C0 scene-object loader state machine, 0x00415230 named format-entry list, 0x00423060 getter, 0x00423CA0/0x00423DB0 steering decomposition helpers, 0x00425660/0x004258C0 AI driver-state resets, 0x00429FD0 tire-tier selection, 0x0042A740 clamp). AIDriver and GenericRuntimeObject AI helpers both reach the vehicle through the this+0 indirection pointer and touch the same 0x44xx/0x45xx race-state region as F1CVehicle methods; a shared vehicle super-struct is plausible but not proven by this packet and is flagged in unresolved.

function_roles.role: Track spline node lookup returning position+orientation (7-float entries at this+0x150) with backwards-neighbour fallback, linear interpolation, and node-0 fallback
Linked-list traversal: head->cursor save, per-node ConditionalMatchTrigger(value, a2) call, next-pointer advance until null
Seven-mode scene-object load/unload state machine: modes 0-5 branch on sub_45A8E0 into clear/keep paths; mode 6 gates vehicle physics, runs suspension update, copies sub-object position
Named format-entry lookup (name + secondary key) over a singly-linked list; on miss allocates/initializes/appends a 176-byte entry and returns its index
Trivial getter: returns the dword at this+0xC4 with no side effects
Decompose target vehicle velocity into longitudinal (this[6]) and lateral (this[4]) components relative to a direction vector, called every frame from AISteering
Decompose target vehicle position offset into longitudinal (this[3]) and lateral (this[1]) distance relative to a direction vector, called every frame from AISteering
Vehicle race-struct constructor: tire-system and sub-object construction, AI state flag clear, ~50-field sentinel/zero initialization across 0x413C..0x461C
Per-driver AI ability config load via string-keyed config lookups, difficulty/grip scaling, start-performance assembly, and season-gated mechanical-failure scheduling
Per-frame AI driver camera viewport/frustum and AI-state reset: sentinel writes, slot-array reset, distance accumulator, AI flag clear, command-queue flush, ring-buffer init
Unconditional clear of the 4-byte field at this+0x4510 (driverStatus); called per-frame from AIMainUpdate
AI steering dynamics reset: zero accumulator at +0x4434, 1.0f multiplier at +0x4438, speed/threshold-gated driverStatus=2 write
Per-frame AI steering-angle computation toward the target waypoint with speed-dependent scale, reversing sign, 0.1/frame rate limit, and [-1,1] clamp
Per-frame AI pit-stop strategy init: tire-compound resolve, five-slot pit-schedule seed, fuel-adjusted lap targets, speed/lap-time factor, weighted tier selection tail path
Tire-compound tier selection from grip level flt_8AFEE8 with randomized mid-range boundaries; maps tier to compound index by scanning the compound list
Clamp float at this+0x4484 into [5.0, a2]; lower bound 5.0 sourced from global flt_59E7EC

class_proposals.responsibility: Vehicle race-state holder: constructs the race struct and tire-system sub-object (0x00423E80), resets per-frame AI camera viewport/frustum and AI state (0x00424B20), and computes the per-frame AI pit-stop strategy (0x00429960). state_machines.name: SceneObjectLoaderStateMachine
states: mode_6: vehicle physics + suspension update path
transitions: mode selector at this+0x1C dispatches across 7 targets via jump table jpt_40F1D0 (global:0x0040F2D8)
modes 0-5 call sub_45A8E0(this+0xC) and branch: clear path CameraShakeRingBufferWrite(this)+sub_4BDE20(this) returns 0; keep path sub_4BDE20(this) returns the sub_45A8E0 result

mode 6: if bit 8 of the sub-object vtable entry (*(this+0x20)+0)+0x48BC is set, call VehiclePhysicsModeDispatcher(a2); run SuspensionStateUpdate on the sub-object; copy sub-object position +0x34D4/+0x34D8/+0x34DC into this+0xC/+0x10/+0x14; return 1

interfaces.name: IConfigEntryLookup
interfaces.purpose: Look up a named entry in a string-keyed config list and read its scalar/string payload; used by initAIDriverConfig for per-driver abilities and by AIPitstopStrategyInit for the PitStopStrategy entry.

interfaces.name: IVehicleNameResolver
interfaces.purpose: Resolve the current vehicle's driver-name string (via VehicleLookupByName / CurrentVehicleAccessor) to select per-driver entries; also used as the search key for empty lookup names.

interfaces.name: IVehicleAccess
interfaces.purpose: Obtain the active F1CVehicle through the this+0 indirection pointer used by AI sub-driver objects (driver-name string at vehicle+0x4620, slot-live flag at obj+0x32C8).

compatibility_contracts.name: TrackSplineEntryLayout
compatibility_contracts.description: InterpolateTrackSplineNode (0x00403CD0) requires a spline array at this+0x150 of 7-float (28-byte) entries per node: 3-float position, then 3 orientation dwords at entry+12; an all-zero entry denotes invalid and triggers a backwards-2-node search with linear interpolation at fractional step (a2-v6)/2, else node-0 fallback. A replacement executable must preserve this stride and zero-means-invalid convention.

compatibility_contracts.name: PerDriverConfigKeyStrings
compatibility_contracts.description: initAIDriverConfig (0x00424080) reads per-driver abilities from a string-keyed config list using keys startsdry/startswet/startstalls/qualifyingabil/trackaggressio/rainability/raceability/passing/corneringadd/corneringmult/crash/completedlaps/script; the config list head is the AudioChannelStop return value. A replacement must keep these key spellings.

compatibility_contracts.name: AICommandQueueFlushPerFrame
compatibility_contracts.description: The per-frame AI reset (0x00424B20) must flush the AI command-message queue via AICommandMessageQueueDispatcher(0,0) and initialize ring-buffer fields via AIRingBufferFieldInit before AI steering recomputation; AIClearStateFlags must run before per-frame AI recomputation.

compatibility_contracts.name: PitScheduleStrideLayout
compatibility_contracts.description: AIPitstopStrategyInit (0x00429960) seeds a five-slot stride-4-dword pit schedule anchored near +0x4598 (lap targets at +0x4590/+0x45A0/+0x45B0/+0x45C0, compound slot +0x459C, stop count +0x4588) using dword_8ACF8C as the fill sentinel and 8 as the compound code; a replacement must preserve the 4-dword stride and these anchors.

compatibility_contracts.name: SteeringOutputClampAndRateLimit
compatibility_contracts.description: computeSteeringAngle (0x00426100) writes the AI steering output at this+0x442C rate-limited to at most 0.1 per frame and clamped to [-1.0, 1.0]; reversing mode (driverStatus==6 at +0x4510) inverts the sign. A replacement must reproduce this clamp and limit for identical behavior.

compatibility_contracts.name: NamedFormatEntryAllocation
compatibility_contracts.description: NamedEntryLookupInFormatList (0x00415230) allocates 176-byte entries (OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper) and 12-byte list nodes on lookup miss, initializes two 5-dword sub-structs at entry+16 and three element arrays (entry+56/+96/+136), and runs driver-file-path setup via sub_414600(entry,1) whose non-zero return destroys the partial entry and returns -1. A replacement must preserve entry size and init layout.

subsystem.name: GenericRuntimeObjects
subsystem.responsibility: Per-frame vehicle runtime behaviors and shared runtime helpers: opponent proximity/team awareness, overtake decision, vehicle max-speed/session-flag setters, gearbox shift/RPM rev-match blend, position-change UI state, game post-frame subsystem dispatch, vehicle setup / gear-ratio / replay-state config handling, and shared utilities (directory enumeration, plane/line intersection, matrix multiply, bounded string copy, scaled config-token parsing).

source_proposals.summary: Conservative DERIVED/GUESS architecture for 19 validated functions in the generic_runtime_objects scope. Two functions have CONFIRMED packet ownership (F1CVehicle: 0x0042ACD0 ParameterValueSetter, 0x0042ADB0 SessionCleanupFlagClear); two have DERIVED owners (VehicleSetupConfig: 0x0042E530; VehicleReplayState: 0x0042ECC0). The remaining owners are UNKNOWN and are grouped into GUESS classes only where packet evidence overlaps on the same 'this' base: AIOpponentAwareness (proximity/team scan + overtake decision share +0x403C/+0x4420/+0x45FC/+0x0), VehicleControlAndPositionUIState (gearbox blend, visual-state change and position/lap UI share +0x1C58/+0x1E7C/+0x1EF0/+0x1EF4/+0x1EF8/+0x1F00 and a direct 0x00443B70 -> 0x00447E00 call), plus small GUESS utility classes. GamePost (0x0042DA30) is modelled as a frame-post dispatcher over a FramePostHook interface. No state claimed CONFIRMED by the worker.

function_roles.role: Per-frame opponent awareness: reset 5 proximity + 5 team slots, register nearest vehicle or scan active-vehicle list, sorted-insert nearest candidates, match/fill team slots, consume one-shot re-seed flag.
Sets vehicle maxSpeed from an int parameter; value 18 selects the idle/reverse speed target constant, otherwise the raw value cast to float. Recalculated every frame so external pokes do not persist.
Per-frame session-active flag setter: read RetiredFlag, and when not retired clear the cleanup flag and set the AIControlFlag; returns the original retired byte.

Overtake acceptance decision: replay bail-out, shared max-speed update, session-type/lap/best-lap gates, target-identity and overtake-state checks, pit/stop eligibility, commit target + direction only when car condition != 2 and fuel-rate factor > 0.001.
Game post-frame dispatch: set game phase word to 6, conditionally log, invoke every engine subsystem Post() hook in sequence, then write dword_7C56A0 = 3; returns the session-state setter result.
Shared setup-value parser: parse token triplet, scale two doubles, store truncated int, parse and clamp an index into [0, count-1].

Per-frame vehicle setup update: gear-index clamping over the +0xBC4 table, event vs comparator mode over config-value blocks, rear-spoiler / ride-height / setup-index re-matching, session-value decrement, road-course reset.

Load gear-ratio config via GearRatioConfigFileReader, propagate final-drive value from +0x1978 into +0x1640, replicate the +0x1970 DWORD into 8 replay-state slots at +0x1680 (64-byte stride); returns pointer one past the last slot.
Weighted-ratio lookup via RatioCalculator with a table base, a row index and the column at +0x1644; negates the result for index 43.
Bounded string copy of at most 63 chars into the buffer at this+112 with a NUL terminator written at +0xAF.
Indexed call-through: computes &this[4*a3+7336] and passes it with a4 and seven zeros to sub_565870; joint target-position semantics not evidenced by this packet.
Directory/file enumeration: build search path, clear and refill two linked lists (directories vs files), merge-sort both, increment the counter at +0x1C, free the temp buffer.
Plane/line intersection ratio: computes t for a segment against a plane parameterized on this+0x0/+0x8; returns FLT_MAX on degenerate plane or zero denominator.
Constructor stub: clear +0x9C, call PhysicsBufferClear, return this; straight-line, no guards.
3x3 matrix (this[0..8]) times 3-vector multiply into output vector a3; returns input vector a2. Structural twin of the Matrix3x3VectorMultiply cluster.
BVH traversal filter: mode-dependent double threshold comparisons (mode at +0x1E14) returning whether a volume extends beyond the test distance; used for collision pruning.

Per-frame gearbox shift / RPM rev-match blend: wheel-speed target averaging, gear-ratio selection, throttle blend coefficient, rev-limit clamp, speed-limiter engagement/decay with HUD and position/lap side-effects, RPM vibration disturbance, random throttle perturbation.
HUD visual-state transition: store new state byte when changed, then on the noise path compute noise-modulated scale/alpha and call HUDElementConfig(40, 2, alpha, scale).
Position/lap-change state handler: encode direction into +0x1EF8, copy branch reference data, fire branch-specific sound triggers, set UI state 2/3/5/6 and commit UI params.

subsystem.name: GenericRuntimeObjects
subsystem.responsibility: Collection of small, mostly-standalone runtime object facilities reconstructed from validated function IR: a 2D collision grid query (SpatialGrid), an HDV parse-and-accumulate helper, a large collision-sensor container that also runs the per-frame entity-visibility/dispatch grid update, a linked-list ownership container destructor, a broadphase collision-pair partition list, the profile-create UI page handler, a tire-compound selection state/table cluster, a camera pose-update object, an AI incident cooldown gate, and several small flag/setter utilities.

source_proposals.summary: Proposed DERIVED/GUESS architecture for the generic runtime object cluster. The 21 functions group into a few defensible classes: SpatialGrid (world-to-cell collision query with cached-surface invalidation), HdvVehicleFileParserHelper (accumulates .hdv parameter values into a caller dword), CollisionSensorContainer (constructor-style init of 104 sensor entries on a 560-byte stride plus the per-frame visibility/dispatch grid update over linked lists at +0xE5B0/+0xE5C0; ctor uses base 'this', update uses base 'obj', shared scale defaults at +0x60/+0x64), BroadphasePairList (inner proxy list with head/tail/current/count refined against an outer list), OwnershipListContainer (vtable + five owned pointers + three ownership-flag lists, destructor), ProfileCreatePageHandler (unique-name create vs already-exists flow), TireCompoundSelector (mode/flag switch at +0x128..+0x130, 64-byte-stride cyclic index navigation, float-to-index clamp, part-name to compound-ID mapping), CameraObject (target-tracking / rotation-matrix pose update with spatial-grid height adjustment), AIIncidentCooldownManager (cooldown timestamp at +0x1A0 gates per-frame incident firing), SettingsRegistrationObject (flag at +0x10 mirrored into global dword_7CE2E8 which gates linked-list append), and BitFlagByteAccessor (bit-7 set/clear). Three functions stay owner UNKNOWN: NoopStub, the per-frame post-update dispatcher, and the indexed-slot setter. Function IR and packet evidence outrank this synthesis; all structure is DERIVED or GUESS.

function_roles.role: SpatialGridQuery: maps a world position through the grid origin/scale doubles into 32x32 cell indices and returns the cached colliding surface, re-traversing the cell BVH on cache miss; used by suspension, contact generation and camera paths.

ParseHdvFileAccumulateValues: parses a .hdv file into a session struct, accumulates six parameter values plus a tyre-model contribution into the caller's output dword, frees all parsed-data allocations, returns AND-combined success.
BitFlagSetter: sets or clears bit 7 (0x80) of the byte at this+0x0 depending on argument a2; returns a2 unchanged.

LargeStructInitialization: constructor-style init of the large collision-sensor container - zeroes leading block and tail dwords, creates 104 sensor entries on a 560-byte stride with callback sub_464D20 and CollisionSensorInit, initializes the QPC timer, sets scale defaults (1.0f) and -1 sentinels, fills a 0x1A0-byte block with 0xFF.

UpdateEntityVisibilityGrid: per-frame visibility manager update - derives a budget, classifies rank into an LOD factor, rebuilds and merge-sorts the candidate entity list, dispatches visibility/computation work per entity under the budget cap, appends progress-bar events for rank-out entities, publishes the object base to dword_7CD2AC.

ProfileAlreadyExistsPageHandler: UI page handler for profile creation - unique name path creates the profile (result 0); already-exists path shows the message and dispatches the prompt (result -1); finalizes via two dispatch objects fetched from dword_7CD8C0.
NoopStub (nullsub_2): empty function body; no reads, writes, calls or guards; placeholder or intentionally disabled handler called once by PlayerOptionsInitializer.

ListAndPointerDestructor: destructor - resets the vtable pointer at this+0x0, runs MultiListDestructorWithCleanup, conditionally frees five single pointers (this+0xA0..0xC0), walks and frees three ownership-flag linked lists (heads at +0x70, +0x54, +0x44), zeroes every list header, returns a final cleanup helper result.

BroadphasePairPartition: broadphase collision-partition pass over two proxy lists - non-overlapping pairs are refined with sub_491680/RectangleClipping and re-appended to the inner list; overlapping pairs are unlinked from the inner list and re-prepended to the outer list.

ShortComputation_f070: per-frame post-update dispatcher - mode dispatch, camera-shake clamp, booted/kicked check, session-mode update, steering-wheel animation, conditional resource thunk when dword_8AB6E4 != 2, post-frame sub-handler, and a gated position/speed overlay rendering path.

ShortComputation_1b70: conditional linked-list append - when global dword_7CE2E8 is non-zero appends `this` to a linked list via LinkedListAppend_1dc0 and returns its result, otherwise returns `this`; shared tail hook for eight setter/wrapper functions.
FlagSetterWithGlobalUpdate: writes byte flag a3 into the object at +0x10, mirrors it as an object pointer into global dword_7CE2E8, returns the mirrored pointer.
TripleDispatchWrapper: copies three string arguments via StringCopyWithBufferRealloc then finalizes via ShortComputation_1b70; string-copy setter wrapper.

Camera: camera position/yaw update - target-tracking path (normalized offset, clamped orientation, ring-buffer noise, atan2 yaw) or rotation-matrix path (EulerToRotationMatrix + noise); spatial-grid collision query adjusts camera height when the sound-source handle at this+0x64 is valid; writes the final pose back via Vec3CopyToStruct.

AIIncidentCooldownCheck: per-frame AI incident trigger - blocks incidents for slow AI cars (speed delta in (-55,0) with state guards), then fires only when the cooldown timestamp at this+0x1A0 is expired (writes now+18.0); weighted by session type, race progress, active-vehicle ratio and session-time progress.
Indexed_Field_Setter_with_Flag: indexed slot setter - reads the slot index from a2+4 and stores a2 (flag a3 non-zero) or NULL into this[index]; returns a2 unchanged.
StateTransition: mode/flag switch - a2==0 resets this+0x128 to 1 and clears +0x12C/+0x130 (returns 0); a2 non-zero activates (mode 2, flags 1/1, returns 1) unless already active (returns 2).

IncrementIndexWithWrap: increments a per-entry index in a 64-byte-stride table (this + 16*a2 dwords), wraps via the flag byte at base+53 when it reaches the bound at base+40; entry 0 returns a conditional dispatch call; selector 2 normalizes via FindZeroResultIndex.

DecrementIndexWithWrap: decrements a per-entry index in a 64-byte-stride table and wraps below zero; wrap direction is the inverse of IncrementIndexWithWrap; entry 0 returns a conditional dispatch call; selector 2 normalizes via FindZeroResultIndex.
ClampedIndexAssignment: converts a float into a clamped table index - CRTFtol((a2 - this+0x58) / this+0x60 + 0.5), clamps into [0, this+0x68-1], stores at this+0x6C, returns the unclamped index.

GuardedCallWithCheck: resolves the nth valid part via NthValidPartLookup(this, a2), substitutes fallback byte_5EA438 when the part string is empty, and maps it through TireCompoundNameIDMapping to a tire-compound name ID; returns null when no valid part exists.

class_proposals.name: SpatialGrid
class_proposals.responsibility: 2D collision grid: maps a world position through origin and inverse-cell-size doubles into 32x32 cell indices; each cell holds a BVH tree pointer used to resolve the colliding surface for a query position, with a per-query cached-surface pointer that is invalidated and recomputed on cache miss.

class_proposals.name: HdvVehicleFileParserHelper
class_proposals.responsibility: Parses a vehicle .hdv file into a session struct and accumulates a set of selected parameter values plus a tyre-model contribution into a caller-supplied output dword; frees all parsed-data allocations and AND-combines the selector-call success flag.

class_proposals.name: CollisionSensorContainer
class_proposals.responsibility: Large runtime object owning 104 collision-sensor entries on a 560-byte stride (constructor-style initialization) and the per-frame entity-visibility/dispatch grid update that rebuilds, sorts and drains candidate (obj+0xE5B0) and visibility (obj+0xE5C0) linked lists under a per-frame budget. The constructor uses packet base 'this' while the update uses base 'obj'; common ownership is DERIVED from the shared scale defaults at +0x60/+0x64 and the shared 4-slot list headers at +0xE5B0..0xE5CC.

class_proposals.name: BroadphasePairList
class_proposals.responsibility: Collision broadphase partition list: maintains an inner linked list of AABB proxies (head/tail/current/count at +0x0..+0xC) and repartitions pairs against an outer proxy list - non-overlapping pairs are refined via sub_491680/RectangleClipping and re-appended, overlapping pairs are unlinked and re-prepended to the outer list.

class_proposals.name: OwnershipListContainer
class_proposals.responsibility: Container owning a vtable pointer at +0x0, five optional single pointers (this+0xA0..0xC0) and three ownership-flag linked lists (heads at +0x70, +0x54, +0x44); the destructor tears down all three lists, conditionally frees the single pointers and the per-node data, and zeroes every list header.

class_proposals.name: ProfileCreatePageHandler
class_proposals.responsibility: UI page handler for profile creation: pulls child control 3 from the page control (this+0x40) via its vtable, validates the entered player name for uniqueness, creates the profile on success (result 0) or shows the 'profile already exists' message and dispatches the prompt (result -1), then finalizes through two dispatch objects fetched from dword_7CD8C0.

class_proposals.name: TireCompoundSelector
class_proposals.responsibility: Per-object tire-compound/part selection: a mode/flag switch at +0x128..+0x130 (codes 0/1/2), cyclic index navigation over a 64-byte-stride entry table (index at base+44, bound at base+40, wrap-direction flag at base+53), float-to-index clamping via this+0x58/+0x60/+0x68/+0x6C, and part-name to compound-ID resolution. Grouping is GUESS, largely linked by the shared pit-stop tire-compound decision caller.

class_proposals.name: CameraObject
class_proposals.responsibility: Camera position/yaw update for a 3D object (vehicle/pit-crew camera): target-tracking path (normalized offset, clamped orientation, ring-buffer noise, atan2 yaw) or rotation-matrix path (EulerToRotationMatrix + noise); when the sound-source handle at this+0x64 is valid a spatial-grid collision query adjusts the camera height; the final pose is written back via Vec3CopyToStruct.

class_proposals.name: AIIncidentCooldownManager
class_proposals.responsibility: Per-frame AI incident trigger gate: iterates the vehicle slot array (count dword_5C329C), zeroes inactive slots, blocks incidents for slow AI cars near the player (speed delta in (-55,0) plus state guards), then fires an incident only when the cooldown timestamp at this+0x1A0 is expired (writes now+18.0); firing is weighted by session type, race progress, active-vehicle ratio and session-time progress.

class_proposals.name: SettingsRegistrationObject
class_proposals.responsibility: Object registered into a global-flag-gated linked list by string-setting setters: the flag byte at +0x10 is mirrored into global dword_7CE2E8, and ShortComputation_1b70 appends the object to the list only while that global is non-zero; TripleDispatchWrapper copies three strings then runs the shared tail hook.

class_proposals.name: BitFlagByteAccessor
class_proposals.responsibility: Tiny flag manipulator: sets or clears bit 7 (0x80) of the byte at this+0x0 based on an incoming boolean; returns the requested state unchanged.

states: already-active: mode_field(+0x128)=2, no state change, returns 2

interfaces.name: SpatialGridQuery
interfaces.purpose: Query interface mapping a world position into the 2D collision grid and returning the resolved colliding surface, caching it in the caller's query struct and re-traversing the cell BVH on cache miss; consumed by suspension (0x00401340), contact generation (0x00436870) and the camera path (0x004A3B50).

interfaces.name: UIVtableDispatch
interfaces.purpose: Page-control and dispatch-object vtable methods used by the profile page flow: child-control fetch at vtable+28, message display at vtable+4, and dispatch-object methods at +160/+56 fetched from the dword_7CD8C0 dispatch table.

compatibility_contracts.name: SpatialGridQueryCacheContract
compatibility_contracts.description: The grid object stores origin and inverse-cell-size doubles at +0x8..+0x20 and addresses 32x32 cell slots from a grid base (indexed by cell indices), each slot holding a BVH tree pointer. A query struct holds a cached surface pointer (a2+48) and a validity byte (a2+88); SpatialGridQuery returns the cached pointer on a hit, otherwise clears it, maps the world position into cells, and re-traverses the cell BVH. A replacement must preserve the cache-invalidation semantics (cached surface invalid when NULL, validity byte set, or QuadraticSurfaceCollisionTest fails).

compatibility_contracts.name: VehicleRankArrayStrides
compatibility_contracts.description: The visibility grid indexes a 0x48C0-stride vehicle array at 0x005EC6D8 (per-rank entity data base, 18624 = 0x48C0 bytes per rank), and rank tables at 0x005EF9A0 (4656-byte stride entries, -1 marks an invalid rank that falls back to the slot index) and 0x005F0F88 (9312-byte stride). A replacement must preserve these strides and the -1 invalid-rank sentinel.

compatibility_contracts.name: ProfileCreatePageResultContract
compatibility_contracts.description: The profile-create page returns 0 when the entered name (byte_7CD818) is unique and the profile is created, and -1 when the name already exists, showing the 'profile already exists' message on the page control and dispatching the prompt via LookupDispatch(-1). The one-shot 'player name never used' message is gated by byte_7D2E41 and cleared after display.

compatibility_contracts.name: AIIncidentCooldownContract
compatibility_contracts.description: An AI incident fires only when the cooldown timestamp at this+0x1A0 is expired relative to the session-time global dbl_8AFEA0, and then rewrites the timestamp to now+18.0 seconds. Session type 7 (dword_7C56A4) always passes; incidents are blocked when a vehicle's speed delta vs the player is in (-55,0) while its state words are in the active/guard configuration. A replacement must preserve the 18-second cooldown and the (-55,0) block window.

compatibility_contracts.name: TireCompoundModeSwitchContract
compatibility_contracts.description: The mode/flag switch at +0x128/+0x12C/+0x130 must preserve its three observable outcomes: reset request returns 0 (mode 1, flags cleared), activation returns 1 (mode 2, flags set), and redundant activation returns 2 without state change.

compatibility_contracts.name: GlobalFlagGatedRegistrationContract
compatibility_contracts.description: Global dword_7CE2E8 gates the linked-list append performed by ShortComputation_1b70 (LinkedListAppend_1dc0); FlagSetterWithGlobalUpdate mirrors the +0x10 flag byte into that global as an object pointer or NULL. A replacement must keep the append gated on the same global flag so setter callers observe identical registration semantics.

compatibility_contracts.name: VisibilityDispatchBudgetContract
compatibility_contracts.description: The per-frame visibility update derives a work budget from DivisionWithCapComputation and the product of the scale defaults at +0x60/+0x64, dispatches entities under a budget cap (converted to 60-unit steps), appends progress-bar events for rank-out entities, and writes leftover budget headroom back into the per-slot word obj+560*a2+692. A replacement must preserve the budget-accounting discipline (dispatch cost 8+(bits>>8)&0x3FF per payload, 60 per entity).

subsystem.name: GenericRuntimeObjects
subsystem.responsibility: Per-frame and lifecycle management of runtime objects: per-vehicle scene render update, starting-grid slot allocation and grid-data dispatch, telemetry session output, steward post-race cleanup, render/UI-widget state control, subsystem-slot lifecycle, vibration/force-feedback, brake-thermal and aerodynamic physics helpers, position tracking, race-start countdown, and shared level-gated debug logging.

source_proposals.summary: DERIVED-source architecture proposal for a grab-bag of generic runtime objects. SceneRenderUpdate (0x004C6D90, VehicleObject, DERIVED) is the per-frame entry point; it drives a starting-grid data-dispatch chain (0x004D10E0/0x004D1100/0x004D1140) backed by the grid-slot allocator 0x004C6F10, all reading the setup-scene array dword_5EA2C0. TelemetrySession (0x004D4A80, DERIVED) writes a CSV-style session file with a fixed header, checksums and XOR-decoded driver data. Steward_Post (0x004D4600) tears down audio/comparison/camera state and resets every vehicle substate. UpdateRenderState (0x004E0ED0, VehicleRenderStateController, DERIVED) drives HUD widget visibility by render mode 0-3. A cluster of physics helpers (0x004E87E0, 0x004E8B80, 0x004E9630) reads a shared this+0x34xx..0x3Dxx region. VibrationStateMachine (0x004E2230) is an OFF/LOW/HIGH magnitude-gated force-feedback machine. SplitPathAndWriteDebugLog + DebugLogWrite (0x004D7A50/0x004D7AA0) form a level-gated debug log service. Most owners are UNKNOWN in the packet and are grouped into GUESS classes on shared-field evidence only.

function_roles.role: Per-vehicle scene render update on the frame path: resets respawn state, applies large physics-config constants, delegates to a global-instance callback, dispatches grid-position and render data through the grid dispatch chain, initializes the AI driver struct, runs the vehicle frame update, clears render-flag bit 23 at +0x48B4, updates force feedback on the global base, and runs a collision wrapper when the session-time threshold is not positive.

Starting-grid slot allocator: seeds the slot index from this+0x48A4 = this+0x4894 modulo 52, scans up to 52 slots for an unoccupied one, derives a column-order permutation from this+0x4710, copies the slot position from the setup scene, checks the live vehicle array for a peer occupant of the same slot/column pair, falls back to a rescan, and writes -1 to both indices on failure.

Thin grid-data dispatch: reads the dword at this+0x4058, decrements it by 1, and forwards it as the index argument to the setup-scene array accessor along with dword_5EA2C0 and two passthrough pointers; returns that callee's result unchanged.

Conditional grid-position sync: when the signed grid index at this+0x48A4 is negative (unallocated) it recalculates via 0x004C6F10, then copies grid-slot data from the setup-scene array via ArrayOfStructIndexedFieldCopy and returns that copy's result.

Guarded render-data read: when the grid index at this+0x48A4 is negative it allocates a grid position via 0x004C6F10, then reads indexed struct data from the setup scene via IndexedStructDataRead(dword_5EA2C0, this+0x48A4, this+0x48A8, a2, a3) and returns its result.

Ring-buffer element accessor: truncates a float index scaled by this+0x108, wraps a negative index by adding the buffer size at this+0x10C, clamps into [0, size-1], and returns the first DWORD of the 8-byte-stride element at this+0x110.

Steward post-race cleanup: logs entry, frees the D3D audio state pointer at +0xA8, resets comparison/camera-director state, frees state arrays at +0x110/+0x114, conditionally refreshes season scoring, resets every vehicle substate, frees the counted array at +0x1AC, and zeroes 52 dword-pairs at +0x1B0/+0x280.

Telemetry session start and header write: tears down previous telemetry state, gates on the scoring check, scans the live vehicle array for the player slot, opens the output stream, computes a 1-40 Hz sampling rate, writes the CSV-style column headers (base, per-wheel and tail channels), embeds XML scene config and integrity checksums, XOR-decodes driver data, and frees scratch allocations.

Compound index lookup: validates a2 against the range [0, this+0x10), returns a pointer to the a2-th compound entry at this+0x14 + 680*a2, and on out-of-range index conditionally logs a tire-brand error and returns 0.

Level-gated debug log helper: returns 0 when the severity dword at this+0x0 is below the a2 threshold; otherwise walks a backslash-delimited path via sub_587C20 and emits a formatted debug log entry via DebugLogWrite, returning 1.

Formatted debug log writer: writes the message through the file handle at this+0x4 via FileWriteWrapperWithLock, then flushes/synchronizes via LockCallUnlockWrapper on the same handle and returns its result.

Scene-graph vertex finder: computes a LOD threshold, iterates the node's children, filters each child by its LOD level, scans the child's packed vertex array, keeps the vertex whose dot product with the direction vector is maximal, writes its coordinates to a3, and returns the child count.

Per-car render/UI-widget visibility update: resolves the effective render mode (default 3, overridden by a2 when the obj+0x48BC flags word has bit 1 set) and stores it to this+0x964; computes a HUD gate from byte_7CE254/dword_7D0410; switches on the mode to show or hide a large widget-flag set, performs player-only session-phase audio transitions, and runs an 8-entry per-widget loop.

Subsystem slot lifecycle dispatcher: switches on slot id a2 (0-13); array-backed slots 0-3 route to SubslotCleanup on activation or ArrayEntryCleanup on deactivation, while pointer-backed slots 4-13 route to LazyInitCallback on activation or ConditionalResourceRelease on deactivation.

Vibration/force-feedback state machine: maps |a3| below 16.0 to OFF (0), 16.0-64.0 to LOW (1), and 64.0+ to HIGH (2); on a state change stores the new state at this[74*a2+123], updates the primary slot via sub_5506A0, and iterates the sound-effect slot array applying sub_5506A0 to each non-zero entry.

Brake thermal model: computes a normalized brake thermal factor clamped to [0,1] from a squared suspension-displacement residual, two thermal conversion factors, a heat-capacity term, an offset and a range denominator; returns 0.0 when either divisor is zero.

Aerodynamic force calculation: computes a force from squared speed with a gravity weight-compensation term, a 14-entry linearly-interpolated table lookup, a drag cross-term, and a quadratic-form correction branch; invokes sub_5895A2 on the intermediate force with the result discarded.

Position-change monitor: conditionally registers the current position triplet (this+0x34D4..0x34DC) with the tracking service via sub_403640, saves the previous position into the history slots this+0x3AA0..0x3AA8, and returns the tracking handle at this+0x3A9C.

Race-start countdown advance: clears the in-progress flag each frame, resets phase/timer/step when a2 is zero, otherwise triggers the countdown sound effect, reloads the timer from step-interval fields, records telemetry on the green-light step, and performs the final-step phase transition.

source_proposals.summary: Thirty functions grouped into a 'generic runtime objects' proposal: (1) suspension/adjacency geometry (PhysicsSuspensionNode: UpdateContactGeometry 0x004FAF60 and SignedDistancePenaltyMetric 0x004FB6D0 share the linked-node layout at this+0x10C/0x110/0x114 and the local position at this+0x0/0x4/0x8); (2) wheel physics parameter evaluators (WheelCurveEvaluator 0x004F6A50 DERIVED; WheelForceParameterBlock 0x004F6950; RandomizedParameterBlock 0x004F6850/0x004F6880; SuspensionLinkBlock 0x004F8330), all enable-byte gated and called per-frame from SuspensionAndWheelPhysics-family sites; (3) tire-model initialization (TirePhysicsSystem 0x004F2430, TireModelSubBlock 0x004F3040) called from TireModelDataInit/PhysicsTireSystemConstructor; (4) vehicle-setup file parsing (HdvVehicleSetupParser 0x004F3090 fender-aero section reader and 0x004F3490 abs-tuple parse, both from TheSvmHdvVehicleFileParser); (5) curve evaluators (ParameterizedCurve 0x004F6720, DualQuadraticCurve 0x004F3190); (6) per-instance effect/position state (VehiclePhysicsEffectBlock 0x004F17A0/0x004F1890, VehiclePhysicsState 0x004F0050, CullableRenderObject 0x004EFFD0, TeamEffectLoader 0x004F03E0); (7) HUD/feedback (HudElementArray 0x004F87C0, SignedIndexLookupTable 0x004FAE70); (8) buffered file streams (BufferedFileStream 0x005351D0/0x00535390/0x005355A0, wrapper 0x00534B00); (9) parameter accessors (TripleParameterAccessor 0x0054B3B0/0x0054B420/0x0054B4D0); (10) scene-graph access (SceneGraphNode 0x0054C030, SceneNodePositionCache 0x0054B950). Owners, field semantics and curve coefficient meanings remain mostly unproven; the architecture below records the evidenced structure and leaves the uncertain parts explicit in unresolved.

Projected signed-distance calculator for vehicle physics: fetches a position-monitor struct via PositionChangeMonitor (callee 0x004E9630), forms a direction vector from two monitor position pointers (+268/+272), projects the vehicle offsets this+0x34D4/0x34D8/0x34DC against the monitor origin along the normalized direction plus a stored distance, returns the stored distance on a zero direction, and clamps with flt_5EA3FC[0].

Dispatch wrapper (legacy name Team_Color_Loader): resolves an object-relative parameter at *this + 0x4894 through UtilityFunction_3d50 (callee 0x00463D50) into a 108-dword local buffer, and only if that returns non-zero calls VehiclePhysicsTimeStep(*this, buffer, a2) (callee 0x004C73F0). The local buffer is the sole data channel between the two calls.

Effect parameter setter on the vehicle effect object: writes a2 into the slot at 0x3994, a4 into the slot at 0x3570, and (a3 * the multiplier at 0x397C) into the scaled slot at 0x3978; returns a2 unchanged. Called per-frame from VehiclePhysicsTimeStep (0x004C73F0).

Speed value setter with global mirror: writes the float argument into this+0x3978, then mirrors it into the global dbl_7C75C4 only when the rigid-body constraint pointer at this+0x32BC is null; returns the previously read constraint pointer.

Fixed 4-iteration loop driver: calls sub_4F18C0 with (this, i, a2, 0) for i in 0..3, then if the flag argument a3 is non-zero calls TireBrushModelForceSolver (callee 0x004E8010) with (this, 0). Called from five AI/vehicle-physics sites including AIMainUpdate, AISteeringRacingLineCorrection, PitStopOperationTimer and SuspensionAndWheelPhysics.

Constructor-style zero initializer of a tire physics/data object: runs ConstantsStructInit (callee 0x0040E6A0) over two direct regions (this+12, this+24) and two loop-expanded runs of 7-dword constants structs (starting this+34 x4, this+102 x8), zeroes 20 dword fields via straight-line and loop writes, and returns this.

Zero-initializer for a 0x54-byte sub-object: zeroes a byte at this+0x0 and 20 dwords through this+0x50, returns this. Called once from TireModelDataInit (0x004F34E0), suggesting an embedded tire-model sub-structure.

Fender aerodynamics setup-section reader of a vehicle file: loops over lines via LineInputReader (callee 0x005351D0), uses sub_5651B0 to detect the end of section (break) or skip non-data lines, parses fender center/drag/lift/sideways parameter fields via sub_565AA0 into this-relative slots (this+0x0 set to 1 when FenderCenter parses), and calls CRTMathHelper_e1f0 to fill a per-vehicle indexed flare range/setting block.

Dual quadratic curve evaluator: evaluates two quadratics a2^2*C2 + a2*C1 + C0 with double coefficients (this+0x4/0xC/0x14 and this+0x1C/0x24/0x2C), writing results to *a3 and *a4; when the enable byte at this+0x0 is zero both outputs are 0.0. Returns a3 when enabled, a4 when disabled.

Parse-and-abs tuple setter: fills a three-value tuple at this+0x90/0x98/0xA0 via sub_565AA0, and on parse success applies fabs to each element; returns the parse result. Called from TheSvmHdvVehicleFileParser (0x004F4270).

Called per-frame by brake-temperature, aero and suspension physics.

Randomized scale+bias offset calculator: when the enable byte at this+0x56C is zero, calls the randomization helper sub_5881F0(a2) and scales a2 by the double at this+0x578, otherwise uses a2 unscaled; adds the bias double at this+0x570 and returns the result. Called per-frame by sub_43C250 and SuspensionAndWheelPhysics.

Second variant of the randomized scale+bias computation: same enable gate at this+0x56C and randomization helper sub_5881F0, but using the parameter pair at this+0x588 (bias) and this+0x590 (scale). Called per-frame by sub_43C250 and SuspensionAndWheelPhysics.

Quadratic force/torque model: given input a2 fills torque *a4 and force components a3[0..2] using quadratic polynomials in a2 (coefficient doubles at this+0x314/0x31C/0x324 for torque and this+0x2FC/0x304/0x30C for force) plus two absolute-value force components (this+0x34C, this+0x384); gated by the enable byte at this+0x2F8. Called from WheelForceAggregate, CollisionEnergy and SuspensionAndWheelPhysics.

Enable-flag-guarded quadratic curve evaluator for the wheel curve: when the byte at this+0x4D4 is non-zero writes a2*a2*(this+0x4E8) + a2*(this+0x4F0) + a2*(this+0x4E0) + (this+0x4D8) into *a3, otherwise writes 0.0; returns the flag value. On the per-frame wheel/suspension physics path.
Reciprocal positive-difference helper: v1 = float(this+0x80) - float(this+0x84); writes 1.0/v1 to this+0x88 when v1 > 0.0, otherwise writes 0. Per-frame helper called from SuspensionAndWheelPhysics.

Indexed HUD/feedback element configuration: reads a flag at *(this)+0x32C8 to select the gain source (flt_7CF35C vs flt_7CF338 plus an index increment of 1), selects element result = this + 8*a2, writes gain = v6*a4, writes magnitude a5, sets an enable byte, clamps the index into [0, 3] (or 0 when negative), and clears a byte; returns the element base.

Signed index table lookup: converts float a2 to an integer via CRTFtol (callee 0x00587BDC), then selects a double from two clamped 8-entry regions of a caller-provided float table (indices 59..66 for non-negative input, indices 51..58 for negative input, both clamped to 7).

Suspension contact-geometry update for a physics node, gated by the distance threshold at this+0x12C against dword_5EA2CC: computes the delta vector from the local reference position to a linked neighbor (primary this+0x110, fallback this+0x10C), derives lateral bounds, combined coordinates, delta magnitude and a secondary distance from the tertiary pointer this+0x114, sets an approach angle from atan2 with pi/2 and +pi special cases, and propagates clamped cosine-similarity values into the this+0xBC array through a chain of up to 4 linked nodes.

Call wrapper: invokes sub_534B10 with argument -1 and returns its result unchanged. Callers span file-open, scene/vehicle-file writing and parsing, audio-stream and joint-system load paths, suggesting a shared helper with a -1 sentinel argument.

Line input reader over a buffered file stream: reads single bytes via BufferedFileReader (callee 0x00534F90) until newline (0x0A), the length limit a3 is exhausted, or a read fails; null-terminates the line and returns the buffer pointer, or 0 when no data was stored.

Mode-driven buffered stream read: reads a2 bytes from the stream object; mode a3==0 reads at an absolute offset, a3==1 reads relative to the position at a1+20, a3==2 returns -1. Lazily allocates 0x4000 scratch buffers via MallocWrapperForNhMalloc (callee 0x0058A935) and fills them through BufferFillWithTimeout (callee 0x00535220) or BufferedFileReader loops (callee 0x00534F90), with seek-back via sub_5354E0 (callee 0x005354E0) and sub_587F64; returns -1 on any refused or failed path. Called from file loaders, HDV parsing and resource dispatch.

File-stream close/cleanup with an optional write-flush path: returns -2 for a NULL stream; when the mode byte at this+0x5C equals 119 ('w') and FileReadLoop(this, 4) (callee 0x005352D0) returns 0, runs ArithmeticComparison_55f0 (callee 0x005355F0) twice to sync remaining-buffer state between this+0x40/0x4C and this+0x40/0x8; always hands the stream to a file-handle destructor for final cleanup.

Three-field query: reads fields at this+0x20/0x24/0x28 and writes each to its corresponding output pointer when non-null; returns a4.

Six-field setter with bitmask clear: stores a2/a3/a4 at this+0x20/0x24/0x28, forwards a5/a6/a7 through InterruptDispatch (callee 0x0058957A) and stores them as floats at this+0x2C/0x30/0x34, then clears the bitmask at this+0x40 via BitmaskClear (callee 0x0054B330).

source_proposals.summary: Proposal for the generic_runtime_objects wave: five defensible object groups plus a set of free, ownerless runtime utilities. ParticleVertexBufferManager (DERIVED from the packet) owns a ParticleVertexBufferDescriptor (base *(this+0x1E0)) and a per-particle entry array (base *(*(this+0x1E0)+0x8)); allocateParticleVertexBuffer tears down and rebuilds the buffer and stores sqrt(max squared camera distance) for LOD. ConfigLineParser (DERIVED from the packet for parseConfigLine; extended to three more functions at GUESS level via shared fields this+0x180/0x198 and overlapping callers) parses lines in place and extracts key/value tokens. GrowableStringBuffer (GUESS) tracks a heap buffer at this+0x0 with capacity at this+0x4 and reallocates on append/copy. PhysicsRigidBodyState (GUESS) holds angular velocity, world inertia tensor rows, reciprocal diagonal and computed inertia products, transforming the tensor between frames. NetworkConnectionList (GUESS) owns two singly-linked node lists and duplicates them in 0x0057B330; LinkedListNode (GUESS) captures the uniform 12-byte node layout across both lists. Twelve functions (0x00587BCF..0x0058BB10) plus the 0x005546A0 setter dispatcher are left ownerless: they are free __cdecl/__thiscall shims and orchestrators whose callee bodies are largely outside the packet. Contradictions are recorded in unresolved: packet-prose decimal offsets (this+124, this+188) with no field refs, template prelabel conflicts (0x00589DB0), tail jumps out of the packet body (0x00589DB6), and inference-only return codes.

Orchestrator: writes this[0] from a3 then dispatches to 7 sub-setter callees with consecutive a2[8..14] values; no guards of its own. Semantic meaning of the dispatch payload lives in the callees.

Parses the config/INI line buffer in place at this+408 (==0x198): strips whitespace, // comments and CR/LF, toggles quote state, tracks paren depth, trims trailing spaces and returns a line-classification code (1 empty/space/brace, 2 closing brace, 3 comment-only, 0/4 content).

Config key/value extractor: duplicates the source string at this+0x198 into the object head, tokenizes at asc_5C30AC, rejects a consumed key via sub_588410, re-tokenizes at asc_5C64D4, stores the value at this+0x180 and copies it to an output buffer; returns 1 on success.

Parses a config value at this+0x180 as an integer tuple of size 1-4 using a (%d,...) format chosen by which output pointers are non-null; writes boolean (parsed!=0) into non-null outputs; succeeds when the extraction count equals the expected tuple size.

Tuple serializer/writer: after a sub_565400 precondition, formats a 1-4 value tuple into the buffer at this+0x180 via a (%d,...) format selected by non-zero outputs, falling back to bare %d; returns TRUE when the formatted length equals the number of arguments.

Appends string a2 to a growable string buffer (ptr this+0x0, capacity this+0x4): reallocates via new/free when capacity is exceeded, strcat-appends; delegates to StringCopyWithBufferRealloc when the buffer is empty.

Copies source string into the managed buffer (ptr this+0x0, capacity this+0x4), reallocating via free + new when null or too small; returns 0 on success, -1 on null input. Callee of StringBufferConcatAlloc.

Rigid-body inertia helper: converts Euler angles via EulerAnglesTo33RotationMatrix, transforms the inertia tensor to world space via F_3x3InertiaTensorTransform, computes three dot products of the tensor rows with the angular-velocity vector (this+0x94/0x9C/0xA4) storing doubles at this+0x7C/0x84/0x8C, returns the tensor-transform result.
Copies 0x18 bytes (6 dwords) from a2 into this+124 (packet-prose decimal target; byte offset unconfirmed by field ref), then calls InertiaTensorWorldSpaceTransform and returns its result.

Copies a 0x18-byte inertia-tensor diagonal region from a2 into this+188 (packet-prose decimal target; unconfirmed), writes reciprocals 1.0/a2[i] into this+0xD4/0xDC/0xE4 (numerator constant dbl_59E420), then calls InertiaTensorWorldSpaceTransform. Unconditional; void.

Duplicates two singly-linked lists from source a2 into this: copies connection flag (this+4), frees both destination lists, clones the first list (16-byte socket-address entries in 12-byte nodes) and the second list (4-byte data words), returning 1 (0 on null source). Mutates the source walk pointers a2+16/a2+32.
Free shim: forwards a memory pointer to sub_58AA6F and returns its result. Large cleanup/destructor caller set is consistent with a generic free/delete wrapper; the callee body is outside the packet.
CRT float-to-int64 conversion helper (__ftol): truncates the FPU stack double to __int64 delivered in edx:eax. Identified by the legacy abi name CRT___ftol.

Allocation shim: returns NhMalloc(a1, 1) with a fixed second argument 1; legacy ABI label identifies it as operator new. Used from hundreds of allocation sites (mesh, camera, physics buffers, list nodes, packets, strings, textures).
Two-byte pattern search over a null-terminated haystack: returns match pointer, returns a1 unchanged on empty first byte, 0 when exhausted; single-byte patterns tail-jump to 0x00589DB6.

cdecl string-to-int parser: skips whitespace (category 8), optional sign, accumulates decimal digits (category 4), returns -v when '-' seen. Character classification versioned by the cbMultiByte global (off_5E69C8 vs CharacterEncodingConvertViaLookupTableFallback).

MSVCRT rand(): TLS state at TLS+20 advanced through state = 214013*state + 2531011; returns HIWORD(state) & 0x7FFF. TLS block obtained via TLSValueRetrievalWithInit.
